title: Investigation by the Department of Public Utilities on its own motion into the circumstances surrounding the loss of a fuel purchase agreement by The Berkshire Gas Company and the prudence of The Berkshire Gas Company’s actions related thereto, including whether The Berkshire Gas Company failed to mitigate costs.
